steps.say: A right angle is a square corner, like the corner of a book.
Some angles are smaller than a right angle.
Some angles are bigger than a right angle.
A quarter turn is a right angle. Two quarter turns make a half turn.
Four quarter turns make a whole turn. You end up facing the same way.

check.prompt: Is this angle smaller or bigger than a right angle?

options.why: A right angle is a square corner. This angle opens wider.
The arms open wider than a square corner.

hints: Compare the angle with a square corner.
Put the corner of a book in the angle.
Do the arms open wider than the book corner?
check.explanation: The arms open wider than a square corner, so the angle is bigger than a right angle.

check.prompt: How many right angles are in a half turn?
hints: A quarter turn is one right angle.
How many quarter turns make a half turn?
Turn a quarter, then turn a quarter again.
check.explanation: A half turn is 2 quarter turns, so it is 2 right angles.
